2608.03772.title: Computing Actual Causes for Neural Network Predictions under Structured Causal Inputs
2608.03772.paper_summary: Explaining the predictions of neural networks is a central challenge in trustworthy AI. Existing explanation methods, such as those based on feature attribution or minimal sufficient sets, typically treat input features as independent, which can yield misleading explanations when inputs exhibit structured dependencies. We address this by formalizing explanations as Halpern-Pearl (HP) actual causes, modeling input dependencies using Boolean Structural Causal Models (SCMs). We compute HP causes by applying bound propagation and branch-and-bound techniques, while providing formal guarantees of completeness and minimality. Our experiments show that we substantially outperform brute-force and ILP baselines in scalability, and outperform heuristic search as graph size grows, computing all minimal actual causes on instances with search spaces of up to $2.3\times10^{13}$ candidate (cause, contingency) pairs, on SCMs with up to 28 nodes, within a 180s per-instance budget. In a case study, we further show that ignoring input dependencies inflates the number of reported causes, 14.9% of which are spurious under our SCM.
2608.03772.paper_summary_zh: 解釋神經網絡的預測是可信 AI 中的一個核心挑戰。現有的解釋方法，例如基於特徵歸因或最小充分集的方法，通常將輸入特徵視為獨立的，當輸入顯示結構依賴時，這可能會產生誤導性的解釋。我們通過將解釋形式化為 Halpern-Pearl (HP) 實際原因來解決這個問題，並使用布爾結構因果模型 (SCMs) 來建模輸入依賴性。我們通過應用界限傳播和分支限界技術來計算 HP 原因，同時提供完整性和最小性的正式保證。我們的實驗表明，在可擴展性方面，我們的表現大幅超過了暴力搜尋和 ILP 基準，並且在圖形大小增長時超過了啟發式搜尋，能夠在每個實例的 180 秒預算內，計算出所有最小實際原因，處理的搜索空間高達 $2.3\times10^{13}$ 個候選 (原因，偶然) 配對，SCMs 的節點數最多為 28。在一個案例研究中，我們進一步顯示，忽視輸入依賴性會膨脹報告的原因數量，其中 14.9% 在我們的 SCM 下是虛假的。
